title: Ultrametric Graphons and Hierarchical Community Networks: Spectral Theory and Applications
summary: We develop a theory of ultrametric graphons as limiting objects for random networks with nested hierarchical community structure. A graphon $W:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ is called ultrametric if $W(x,y)=w(d(x,y))$, where $d$ is an ultrametric on $[0,1]$ induced by a family of nested partitions and $w$ is a positive kernel. The resulting random graphs exhibit a nested hierarchical community structure in which the density of connections is governed by the ultrametric distance between vertices. The Laplacian $L_d^k$ of the deterministic graph sampled from an ultrametric graphon is itself an ultrametric…
